# list_files { #crossrepo.gitutil.list_files }

```python
crossrepo.gitutil.list_files(directory)
```

List the files a directory holds, as the parts of one dataset.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**directory**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Location](`crossrepo.location.Location`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Directory to list, on this machine or another.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Paths relative to `directory`, with forward slashes, in a stable order. Empty when the directory is empty or cannot be read.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[GitError](`crossrepo.gitutil.GitError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If a directory on another machine cannot be listed, which is a host that stopped answering rather than a dataset with nothing in it.
